_comment: markdownlint-cli2 config for finops-framework-demo. Tuned for our real-world docs: CHANGELOG.md (Keep-a-Changelog repeats ### Added/Changed/Fixed per release -> MD024 siblings allowed); docs/finops-{en,uk}.md use multiple H1 anchors 'Part 1..4' and 'Appendix A/B' -> MD025 off; footers cite bare URLs like 'aws.amazon.com/kms/pricing' -> MD034 off; pseudo-header emphasis inside list items is stylistic -> MD036 off; mixed/empty code fences (AWS console output) -> MD040 off; long prose lines -> MD013 off; partial include files -> MD041 off; literal <key> placeholders -> MD033 off; per-file consistency for bullet style (- and + both appear) -> MD004 'consistent'; lenient ordered-list prefixes -> MD029 'one_or_ordered'. Kept enabled: MD022, MD031, MD032, MD009, MD012 (these catch real authoring bugs). Unknown top-level keys like _comment are ignored by markdownlint.
